title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available!
summary: Discover powerful new insights with Spyglass, our innovative tool that has officially transitioned from beta to full public availability, ready to empower your decision-making.

title: Enhanced File and Media Management
summary: Take charge of your content with new, intuitive controls that let you manage, display, and interact with your uploaded images and files effortlessly within the editor.

title: Our New Public Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public roadmap to see what we've shipped, what's coming next, and what's planned for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: We've delivered a major upgrade to checkboxes, making them bigger, easier to click, visually consistent, and effortlessly draggable for a smoother task management experience.

title: Enhanced Collaboration Experience
summary: We've significantly enhanced our editor's collaboration features, making it easier and more intuitive for your team to work together in real-time.

title: Enhanced Shared Item Discovery
summary: Easily discover and collaborate on all relevant shared items, empowering seamless teamwork and idea exchange within your network.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We're thrilled to introduce global language support, enabling Noeko users everywhere to enjoy a fully localized and accessible experience.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're open-sourcing Noeko to empower our users with maximum control, foster direct involvement in its growth, and ensure complete transparency.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Constellation
summary: Unleash the full potential of your knowledge base with an intelligently filtered Constellation view, empowering you to navigate and discover connections with unprecedented clarity and control.

title: Precision Search & Saved Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint and organize your most relevant information with powerful new search filters and the ability to save custom collections for instant access.

title: Dynamic Note Layouts
summary: Experience a more intuitive and interactive way to connect and display your notes, empowering you to structure your thoughts with unprecedented clarity.

title: Noeko's Official Launch: Self-Hosted & Premium Plans
summary: Prepare to take full control of your data with Noeko's official launch, introducing flexible self-hosting options and new premium plans tailored for both individuals and enterprises.

title: Elevate Your Style with Enhanced & Expanded Themes
summary: We're refining existing themes for a more polished and vibrant look, alongside introducing a diverse collection of captivating new styles to personalize your Noeko experience.

title: Smarter Time of Day Greetings
summary: Our homepage greetings will now precisely reflect the actual time, providing a more seamless and welcoming experience every time you log in.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged content by directly removing items from tags within your lists, making your workflow smoother and more efficient.

title: Seamlessly Integrate Content from Diverse Sources
summary: Soon, you'll be able to effortlessly add and engage with information from a wide variety of sources, including videos, websites, and text, to build a richer and more comprehensive knowledge base.
